fixes.was: Under the UCC, a reverse-side form term the seller never agreed to does not become part of the contract, and a buyer whose seller was not told of the downstream use assumes the risk that its own customer cannot perform.
fixes.now: Under UCC section 2-207, a buyer's added form term is excluded where the seller's offer barred changes or the contract arose only from conduct, and a buyer whose seller was not told of the downstream use assumes the risk that its own customer cannot perform.
